title: ‘Marshals’ Star Mo Brings Plenty Seeks Justice for Nephew: “He Was Our Future”
summary: The 'Yellowstone' veteran — who continues his role both on- and off-screen in the CBS spinoff — talks to The Hollywood Reporter about shining a light on reservation stories, including with the tragedy of '1923' star and nephew Cole Brings Plenty, who died at age 27 in 2024.
